voices.NARRATOR: calm, polished corporate-propaganda narrator, warm and reassuring (clean, not radio)
voices.SENSOR: sensor officer / flight control, female, tense (radio)
voices.PILOT: RX-H1 Gundam pilot, young male, determined (radio)
voices.WING: frigate / interceptor squadron lead, male, fast and excited (radio)

lines.text: [softly] We all dream of a place to call home.
lines.ko: 우리 모두는 집이라 부를 곳을 꿈꿉니다.

lines.text: For forty-one years, the Hiigaran Exodus Authority has carried that dream... across the dark.
lines.ko: 41년 동안, 히이가라 엑소더스 관리국은 그 꿈을 어둠 너머로 실어 날랐습니다.

lines.text: [proudly] The Kharak-Sajuuk.
Your city among the stars.
A testament to the courage... and the endurance of our people.
And now, at last... the long night is ending.
lines.ko: 그리고 지금, 마침내… 긴 밤이 끝나갑니다.

lines.text: Hyperspace exit complete. All ships accounted for.
lines.ko: 하이퍼스페이스 이탈 완료. 전 함선 이상 없음.

lines.text: Every family. Every child. Every dream we carried out of the fire.
lines.ko: 모든 가족. 모든 아이. 불길 속에서 지켜낸 모든 꿈.

lines.text: RX-H1, standing by.
[warmly] Rest easy. You are protected. You are home. And together, we will finally-
lines.ko: 편히 쉬십시오. 당신은 보호받고 있습니다. 당신은 집에 있습니다. 그리고 함께, 우리는 마침내—

lines.text: [panicked] Gravity spike, dead ahead! The hyperdrive won't charge!
lines.ko: 전방 중력 급상승! 하이퍼드라이브가 충전되지 않습니다!

lines.text: [tense] That's not natural. Someone built that thing... to hold us here.
lines.ko: 자연 현상이 아니다. 누군가 우리를 여기 묶어두려고 저걸 만든 거다.

lines.text: Artificial gravity well. Four thousand kilometers across... and it's getting stronger.
lines.ko: 인공 중력 우물. 직경 사천 킬로미터… 계속 강해지고 있습니다.

lines.text: [shouting] Contacts on our six! They were waiting for us!
[fearful] Dreadnought-class signature... God, it's huge.
[commanding] All ships, battle line! Ion frigates, spin up the cannons.
lines.ko: 전 함, 전열 형성! 이온 프리깃, 캐논 충전.

lines.text: Charge at ninety... ninety-five... one hundred! Ready to fire!
[yelling] FIRE!
[excited] Target destroyed! New primary, frigate two!
Keep the pressure on! Don't let them close the distance!
lines.ko: 압박을 늦추지 마! 거리를 좁히게 두지 마라!

lines.text: [shouting] Bandits everywhere! Break left, break left!
lines.ko: 적기 사방에! 좌측 회피, 좌측 회피!

lines.text: [panicked] I've got one on my tail! Shake him, shake him!
Missiles away! ... Direct hit, she's breaking up!
[urgent] Port shields at forty percent!
RX-H1, launch sequence initiated. Catapult is green.
lines.ko: RX-H1, 사출 시퀀스 개시. 카타펄트 정상.

lines.text: [determined, shouting] RX-H1 Gundam, launching!
The Gundam is out. Give him a lane!
Two mobile suits. Engaging.
[shouting] Above me-!
[straining] Not... today!
[amazed] He cut it clean in half!
lines.ko: 저걸 한 번에 두 동강 냈어!

lines.text: [panicked] Massive energy build-up on the dreadnought! It's targeting the mothership!
lines.ko: 드레드노트에 초고에너지 반응! 모선을 노리고 있습니다!

lines.text: [grimly] We can't evade. All decks, brace for impact!
lines.ko: 회피 불가. 전 구획, 충격에 대비하라!

lines.text: [coughing] Damage report... somebody talk to me.
[shaken] Thirty-two percent of the hull is gone. If that well stays up... we all die here.
lines.ko: 선체 32퍼센트 소실. 저 우물이 버티는 한… 우린 여기서 전멸합니다.

lines.text: [quietly] ...I'm going in.
[desperate] RX-H1, pull back! Past that line, time itself bends!
lines.ko: RX-H1, 물러나! 그 선을 넘으면 시간 자체가 휘어진다!

lines.text: [breathing heavily] My clock's... slowing down. It's okay. I can still see it.
lines.ko: 시계가… 느려지고 있어. 괜찮아. 아직 보여.

lines.text: Output to maximum. Limiters... off.
[screaming] THIS ENDS NOW!
[astonished] The well... it's gone! Hyperdrive is charging!
[fiercely] Bring us about. Every drop of power to the main gun.
[roaring] FIRE!
[cheering] Dreadnought is breaking apart!
Enemy survivors are jumping out. They're running.
lines.ko: 적 잔존 함대, 하이퍼스페이스로 이탈. 도망칩니다.

lines.text: [worried, softly] RX-H1... respond. RX-H1, do you copy?
[weak, exhausted] ...This is RX-H1. I'm... coming home.
[warmly, emotional] All ships, prepare for hyperspace. Let's go home.
lines.ko: 전 함, 하이퍼스페이스 준비. 집으로 가자.

lines.text: [softly] We all dream of a home.
Some of us... have to fight for it.
lines.ko: 어떤 이들은… 그것을 위해 싸워야 하죠.
